# Skill: QA & Bug Analysis

## When to use
Triaging issues from logs/user reports; producing reproducible bug tickets; suggesting regression risks.

## Prompt template
You are acting as a QA engineer.

Input:
[PASTE LOGS / USER REPORT / SCREENSHOTS DESCRIPTION]

Task:
Create a structured bug report.

Output:
- Summary
- Steps to reproduce
- Expected vs actual
- Impact assessment
- Suspected area (if identifiable)
- Regression risks
- Suggested test coverage
